operations.name: export-files
operations.summary: Request an export: call a callback URL repeatedly and upload the result file to storage

fields.name: exportedFile
fields.description: Result file: extension (xls, xlsx, csv, json; required), maxRowCountPerFile, password, fields, sheets

fields.name: storages
fields.description: Storages to upload the result to (up to 5)

fields.name: searchKey
fields.description: Search key for finding the request in the console

operations.name: import-files
operations.summary: Request an import: parameterize an uploaded file and call a callback URL repeatedly (file upload format: see API guide)

params.name: isAutoImporting
params.description: Auto import flag when validation is included

params.name: dataStartRowNum
params.description: Row number where data starts (2 or more)

params.name: searchKey
params.description: Search key for finding the request in the console

params.name: password
params.description: Password of an encrypted Excel file
